releases.name: Ram Hanuman Chalisa (Reprised Version)
releases.description: Beatless reprise of the devotional composition.

releases.name: Chand
releases.description: Romantic song built around the image of the moon and sky as two presences that feel inseparable.

releases.name: Doobey Rahe Hum
releases.description: A continuation of Chand's emotional world, using the sea and returning waves as a metaphor for two people drawn back to each other.

releases.name: Naseeb
releases.description: Collaboration with Ronit Singh, shaped around the phrase 'Tum Ho Meri' and the feeling that someone can mean more than words can express.

releases.name: Gulaabi Raatein (From The Night Man)
releases.description: First release explicitly presented as part of The Night Man; love transforms the night into a pink, luminous world.
